episodes.instruction: Use the left arm to pick up the red can with white top, put it into the yellow rectangular basket with dual grips, the other arm lifts the yellow rectangular basket with dual grips.
Grab the lightweight cylindrical metal can and put it in the yellow rectangular basket with dual grips, then lift the yellow rectangular basket with dual grips.
Use the left arm to put the cylindrical brown drink can with white markings in the oval basket with medium storage space; the other arm lifts the oval basket with medium storage space.
